title: Gajalakshmi
brief_description: Finley carved composite Gajalakshmi sculpture in high relief.
detailed_description: Finely carved composite Gajalakshmi sculpture in high relief watered by two elephants on either side. The four handed deity is seated in padmasana (folded legs) holding lotus in both upper hands; attributes in lower hands are missing. Chest, face and head portion are mutilated. Gajalakshmi wears kiritha mukuta. The composite sculpture probably had adorned the lintel of a Hindu temple during the kadamba period.
